preconditions.expression: len(t) > len(p) and len(p) >= 1 and len(t) <= 200000
preconditions.description: The length of t is strictly greater than p, p is non-empty, and t fits within the 200,000 character limit.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in t) and all(c.islower() for c in p)
preconditions.description: Both words t and p consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == len(t) and set(a) == set(range(1, len(t) + 1))
preconditions.description: The removal sequence a is a permutation of indices from 1 to |t|.
It is guaranteed that p can be obtained as a subsequence of t.

postconditions.description: The result is a non-negative integer within the valid range of removable characters.
After removing the first 'result' indices specified in a, the remaining characters of t still contain p as a subsequence.

postconditions.expression: result == len(t) - len(p) or not is_subsequence(p, t, set(a[:result + 1]))
postconditions.description: The result is maximal; either all possible characters are removed, or removing one more character (the (result+1)-th in the sequence) would make it impossible to form p.
